title: Limpany sheriff's office gold bar
region: New Hanover — south of Horseshoe Overlook
directions: Ride to the burned settlement of Limpany, enter the ruined sheriff's office, and inspect the lockbox beneath the desk.
note: Story Mode only. Sell the bar to a Fence after Fence services are unlocked. Do not confuse this with an Online gold spawn.

title: Granite Pass train wreck — two gold bars
region: New Hanover — Cumberland Forest, the Granite Pass ravine on the Ambarino line
directions: The wreck sits in the ravine southwest of Cotorra Springs, where Cumberland Forest meets the Grizzlies. Climb down to the upright car.
note: Story Mode only. The climb is easy to miss and a fall can kill Arthur, so make a manual save first.

title: Strange Statues puzzle — three gold bars
region: Ambarino — cave east of Donner Falls
directions: Find the hidden cave entrance near the mysterious hill home area. In the statue room, use the finger-count clue and press the prime-number statues: 2, 3, 5, and 7.
note: Story Mode only. The center statue opens after the correct buttons are active; rear buttons reset mistakes.

title: Braithwaite Manor ruins gold bar
directions: Return to the burned manor after the Chapter 3 story events and search the ruined interior for the lockbox.
note: Story Mode only and story-gated. The bar is not available before the manor is destroyed.

title: Jack Hall Gang treasure — two gold bars
directions: Begin with Maximo near Flatneck Station, follow the Caliban's Seat and Cotorra Springs maps, then search beneath the rock on the small island in O'Creagh's Run.
note: Story Mode treasure chain. The final cache is not meant to be collected without progressing through its maps.

title: High Stakes treasure — three gold bars
region: New Hanover — cliffs northeast of Fort Wallace
directions: Obtain the first map from the roaming treasure hunter, solve Cumberland Falls and Barrow Lagoon, then follow the narrow cliff ledges and low overhang near Fort Wallace.
note: Story Mode treasure chain. Use a manual save before the final cliff route.

title: Poisonous Trail treasure — four gold bars
directions: Start with the map in the Cairn Lake cabin, solve the Face Rock and serpent mound clues, then enter behind the Elysian Pool waterfall and navigate the cave to the final chamber.
note: Story Mode treasure chain. Bring a lantern and save before the cave because the drops and passages are easy to misread.

title: Landmarks of Riches — six gold bars
directions: Start at the obelisk northwest of Owanjila, follow the landmark clues across the world, then inspect the stone sundial at the top of Mount Shann.
note: Story Mode treasure chain added to later game versions. Six bars are in the final cache.

title: Emerald Ranch Fence
directions: Seamus's wagon barn on the south side of Emerald Ranch. The fence sells ammunition and buys valuables. Story access opens in early Chapter 2.
note: Shop. Cross-checked with the Emerald Ranch fence coordinate used by story-mode maps.

title: Saint Denis Fence
directions: The Saint Denis fence is in the market, northeast of the stables. He sells ammunition and special ammo and buys valuables.
note: Shop. The pin is the fence's published stall coordinate, not a random alley.

title: Rhodes Fence
directions: The Rhodes fence stands on the northeast side of town, off the general-store block. He sells ammunition and buys valuables.
note: Shop. Placed from the Rhodes town block, northeast of the sheriff's office.

title: Aberdeen Pig Farm recovery stash
region: Lemoyne — Scarlett Meadows, southeast of Emerald Ranch
directions: If the Aberdeen encounter takes Arthur's money, return to the pig farm southeast of Emerald Ranch and look behind the portrait near the front door.
note: Story Mode encounter. This marker is for recovering money taken during the event, not a repeatable free-cash spawn.

title: Online treasure-map search areas
region: Red Dead Online — location changes with each map
directions: Open the treasure map from your satchel, travel to the highlighted search zone, then use Eagle Eye and listen for the treasure-chest sound while checking rocks, trees, ruins, and ledges.
note: Online maps award gold nuggets, cash, and items. The chest position is selected from multiple possible spots, so ask Frontier about the exact named map shown on your screen.

title: Valentine bounty board
directions: This pin is the Valentine bounty board. Other towns and stations have their own boards. In Red Dead Online, bounty work needs the Bounty Hunter license.
note: The board coordinate is the Valentine bounty-board interior. Payouts change with the role and with limited-time bonuses.

title: Collector jewelry and sets
region: Red Dead Online — rotating world locations
directions: Use the Collector role tools, search with Eagle Eye, and sell complete sets to Madam Nazar when practical. Ask Frontier to check the current cycle before starting a route.
note: Jewelry and collectible spawns rotate. This app should verify current information instead of pretending a static marker is always correct.

title: Daily Challenges and Awards
directions: Open the Player menu or Progress menu, review today's general and role challenges, then group nearby objectives into one route. Reset eligible completed Awards for additional gold when available.
note: Daily objectives and event bonuses change. Frontier uses live search for the current list and should label any community-reported route information.

title: Legendary Bluegill
region: Lemoyne — Flat Iron Lake, south of Clemens Point
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: Fish the shore south of Clemens Point. Mail it to Jeremy Gill. You can also meet this fish while fishing with Kieran in Chapter 3. Lure: Special Lake Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Bullhead Catfish
region: Lemoyne — creek deltas west of Sisika Penitentiary
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: Row the creeks west of Sisika. IGN also calls this fish the Legendary Catfish. Lure: Special River Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Chain Pickerel
region: New Hanover — Dakota River hairpin near Flatneck Station
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: The hairpin of the Dakota between Flatneck Station and Horseshoe Overlook. Lure: Special River Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Longnose Gar
region: Lemoyne — swamp between Lakay and Lagras
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: Fish the swamp water between Lakay and Lagras, in Bayou Nwa. Lure: Special Swamp Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Largemouth Bass
region: New Austin — San Luis River, southeast of Lake Don Julio
directions: Epilogue. IGN's lure table says Special Lake Lure. The same page's blurb also says Special River Lure. Try the lake lure first. Lure: Special Lake Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Muskie
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: Fish beside the lighthouse at the south end of Van Horn. Lure: Special River Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Perch
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: Fish the pool by the waterfall, southwest of Annesburg. Lure: Special Lake Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Redfin Pickerel
region: New Austin — Stillwater Creek, between Thieves' Landing and MacFarlane's Ranch
directions: Epilogue. Use the largest pool of Stillwater Creek. Lure: Special Lake Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Rock Bass
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: The basin at the head of the Lower Montana River, west of Manzanita Post. Lure: Special Lake Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Sockeye Salmon
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: Fish the lake. Ordinary sockeye use a river lure. This one uses the Special Lake Lure. Lure: Special Lake Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Smallmouth Bass
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: Fish Lake Owanjila, west of Strawberry. Lure: Special Lake Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Lake Sturgeon
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: The mouth of the Lannahechee between Saint Denis and Rhodes. A boat works if you would rather not stand on the bridge. Older guides put a sturgeon on the Dakota; IGN's later page puts this one here. Lure: Special River Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Steelhead Trout
region: New Hanover — Kamassa River above Brandywine Drop
chapter: After A Fisher of Fish begins
directions: The Kamassa basin north of Annesburg, upstream from Brandywine Drop. Lure: Special River Lure. Start A Fisher of Fish with Jeremy Gill, buy the special lures in Lagras, and mail the fish from a post office.
note: Legendary fish. Pelt-style quality does not apply. Do not let it fall off the horse before you mail it.

title: Legendary Channel Catfish
region: New Austin — San Luis River, Rio Bravo
directions: You do not catch this fish. During A Fisher of Fish II, Jeremy Gill is pulled under near the San Luis River.
note: Not a bite. After the 13 legendary fish are mailed, the follow-up mission starts here. You get Gill's hat and the Special Spinner.

title: Rare Shotgun
region: New Hanover — Manito Glade, north of Annesburg
directions: Kill or disarm the male hermit at Manito Glade and pick the shotgun up before you leave. If you ride away, it is gone. One half of the Otis Miller map is in a drawer inside.
note: This is not a Lemoyne cabin and it is not the Semi-Auto Shotgun in the Watson's Cabin basement. IGN's hermit page and the Manito Glade entry agree on this shack.

title: Granger's Revolver
region: New Hanover — Granger's Hoggery, north of Flatneck Station
directions: During The Noblest of Men, and a Woman, duel Emmet Granger at the hoggery and pick the revolver up immediately.
note: The hoggery has no separate interior coordinate in the imap set. The pin is north of Flatneck Station, in the Heartlands, which is where the duel is fought.

title: Calloway's Revolver
region: Lemoyne — Bayou Nwa, the gunslinger shack
directions: During The Noblest of Men, and a Woman, duel Jim 'Boy' Calloway at his bayou shack and pick the revolver up immediately.
note: The duel is in Bayou Nwa, not the Roanoke camp prop that shares his name. Loot it before the mission moves on.

title: Flaco's Revolver
region: Ambarino — Grizzlies West, above Cairn Lake
directions: During The Noblest of Men, and a Woman, climb to Flaco Hernández and pick the revolver up as soon as he drops it.
note: The pin is the high-country crate site above Cairn Lake, cross-checked with the Grizzlies duel.

title: Midnight's Pistol
region: Lemoyne — Rhodes station, then the passenger train
directions: Billy Midnight's duel is on a moving passenger train, not in a field. Start the gunslinger chain, board at a station such as Rhodes, and pick the pistol up on the train.
note: A station pin is the honest marker. There is no single patch of ground where the pistol lies.

title: Algernon's Revolver
region: Lemoyne — Algernon Wasp's house, Saint Denis
directions: Finish Algernon Wasp's exotic-request lists. The revolver is the reward, not a crate in the street.
note: The pin is his Saint Denis house. Chapter 4, once the requests are underway.

title: Viking Hatchet
region: New Hanover — Viking burial, northeast of Annesburg
directions: The hatchet is inside the Viking burial mound on the rocky shore northeast of Annesburg. The same site is the hidden-place pin.
note: Take it from the tomb. It is a unique melee weapon, not a shop item.

title: Civil War Knife
directions: Search the Civil War trenches at Bolger Glade. The knife is in the battlefield, south of Rhodes.
note: The battlefield center is the civil-war treasure ground, and the knife guides use that same field.

title: Valentine gunsmith
directions: The gunsmith on Valentine's main street. He sells guns and ammunition, including special ammo once the catalog allows it.
note: Shop. Marked as a store, not a one-time crate. Stock depends on chapter and on what the catalog has unlocked.

title: Rhodes gunsmith
directions: The Rhodes gunsmith. The shop counter sells ammunition. The locked cellar under it is a separate robbery, pinned on the hidden-places map.
note: Shop. Marked as a store, not a one-time crate. Stock depends on chapter and on what the catalog has unlocked.

title: Saint Denis gunsmith
directions: Kuo Chao and Co, the Saint Denis gunsmith, west of the market. Sells guns and ammunition.
note: Shop. Marked as a store, not a one-time crate. Stock depends on chapter and on what the catalog has unlocked.

title: Annesburg gunsmith
directions: The Annesburg gunsmith, up the hill from the station. Sells guns and ammunition.
note: Shop. Marked as a store, not a one-time crate. Stock depends on chapter and on what the catalog has unlocked.

title: Strawberry gunsmith
directions: The Strawberry gunsmith, in the town block with the general store and sheriff. Sells guns and ammunition.
note: Shop. Marked as a store, not a one-time crate. Stock depends on chapter and on what the catalog has unlocked.

title: Tumbleweed gunsmith
directions: The Tumbleweed gunsmith. Epilogue, once New Austin is open. Sells guns and ammunition.
note: Shop. Marked as a store, not a one-time crate. Stock depends on chapter and on what the catalog has unlocked.

title: Van Horn fence
directions: The Van Horn fence, just off the main road. Sells ammunition and buys stolen goods. There is no gunsmith in Van Horn.
note: Shop. Marked as a store, not a one-time crate. Stock depends on chapter and on what the catalog has unlocked.

title: White Arabian
price: Not sold. Guides list a $1,200 base value.
chapter: Chapter 2, after Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego
region: Ambarino — western shore of Lake Isabella, Grizzlies West
directions: Ride the western bank of Lake Isabella. The horse is alone in the snow. Approach slowly, calm it, and save before you try to mount.
note: One per save. If it dies or you lose it, leave the area and return. There is no wild Black Arabian.

title: Red Chestnut Arabian
price: Not sold. Guides list a $250 base value.
region: West Elizabeth — woods west of Lake Owanjila, Big Valley
directions: From Strawberry, ride west past Lake Owanjila and search the woods on the far bank. This is a wild Arabian, not a stable horse.
note: Story mode. The lake is west of Strawberry; the horse is on the west side of the water.

title: Warped Brindle Arabian
price: Not sold. Guides list a $450 base value.
region: Ambarino — west of the Wapiti reservation, Grizzlies East
directions: Search west of the Wapiti Indian Reservation, not the snow at Lake Isabella. It is a single wild horse.
note: Fandom puts this coat west of Wapiti. It is not a stable Arabian.

title: Perlino Andalusian
region: New Hanover — east bank of the Kamassa at Brandywine Drop
directions: Climb the east side of the Kamassa River at Brandywine Drop. The Perlino Andalusian spawns on that cliff, north of Annesburg.
note: Wild. The Dark Bay Andalusian is a different coat and is a stable horse.

title: Wild Nokota
price: Not sold. Guides list about a $130 base value.
region: West Elizabeth — Little Creek River, Big Valley
directions: Ride the Little Creek River valley in Big Valley, northwest of Strawberry. Blue Roan and White Roan Nokotas run in this herd.
note: The Reverse Dapple Roan is a later stable coat, not this wild herd.

title: Tiger Striped Bay Mustang
region: New Austin — Rio Bravo, near Rio del Lobo Rock
directions: After the epilogue opens New Austin, search south of the legendary pronghorn ground, around Rio del Lobo Rock. The Tiger Striped Bay is the rare mustang.
note: Epilogue only. It does not spawn during the main chapters.

title: New Austin mustang herd
directions: The common New Austin mustangs, Grullo Dun and Wild Bay, run in Hennigan's Stead once the epilogue opens the state.
note: Epilogue only. The Tiger Striped Bay is the separate rare coat farther south.

title: Dapple Dark Gray Hungarian Half-bred
region: New Hanover — Heartlands, near Carmody Dell
directions: The Dapple Dark Gray Hungarian Half-bred runs wild near Carmody Dell, in the Heartlands north of Flatneck and west of Emerald Ranch.
note: The Flaxen Chestnut is the early Valentine stable coat, pinned separately.

title: Flaxen Chestnut Hungarian Half-bred
price: Valentine stable price, an early war horse
directions: Buy it at the Valentine stable, at the south end of town by the auction yard. A Flaxen Chestnut also turns up wild in the early Heartlands.
note: Common enough to buy. The rare coat of this breed is the wild Dapple Dark Gray.

title: Few Spotted Appaloosa
region: New Hanover — Heartlands, west of the oil derrick
directions: Search the Heartlands west of the oil derrick and Heartland Overflow. The Few Spotted Appaloosa is the rare wild coat.
note: Two horse guides put this coat in the Heartlands rather than New Austin. The Leopard Appaloosa is a separate, more common pattern.

title: Tennessee Walker herd
coat: Red Roan and other common coats
price: Also sold cheaply at Valentine. Not a rare horse.
region: New Hanover — Heartlands, west of Valentine
directions: Red Roan and other Tennessee Walkers are a common wild herd in the Heartlands just west of Valentine. Stables sell them too.
note: Included because riders ask for the wild Tennessee Walker. It is an ordinary horse, not an elite spawn.

title: Kentucky Saddler
price: Valentine stable, the cheapest coats are well under $150
directions: The Valentine stable, beside the auction yard at the south end of town, stocks Kentucky Saddlers from the start of Chapter 2.
note: A common stable breed, not a rare wild spawn. Pinned because it is the horse most riders buy first.

title: Black Arabian
directions: Buy it at the Saint Denis stable in Chapter 4. There is no wild Black Arabian herd.
note: A night street robbery in Saint Denis can also put this horse in reach. That encounter is a separate pin.

title: Black Arabian night encounter
price: Free if you stop the robber. The stable price is $1,050.
chapter: Chapter 4, at night in Saint Denis
directions: At night in Saint Denis, a robber may hold up a couple and then mount a Black Arabian. Stop him after he is on the horse and you can take it. The same encounter is also reported in Blackwater.
note: This is an encounter, not a standing wild spawn. If it is not happening, the stable still sells the coat in Chapter 4.

title: Rose Grey Bay Arabian
directions: The Blackwater stable sells the Rose Grey Bay Arabian in the epilogue. It is not available in the main chapters.
note: A different coat from the Saint Denis Black Arabian.

title: Gold Turkoman
directions: Buy the Gold Turkoman at the Saint Denis stable in Chapter 4. Horse Flesh for Dinner can also put a Turkoman in the camp, but that mission horse is not this stable coat.
note: Stable. The Dark Bay and Silver coats wait for the epilogue.

title: Dark Bay Turkoman
directions: The Blackwater stable stocks the Dark Bay Turkoman once the epilogue opens the town.
note: Epilogue only.

title: Silver Turkoman
directions: The Tumbleweed stable sells the Silver Turkoman in the epilogue.
note: Epilogue only. The stable sits with the rest of Tumbleweed.

title: Amber Champagne Missouri Fox Trotter
price: Taken during a stranger mission. A Chapter 4 stable sale is also reported, but the guides do not agree which stable.
chapter: Albert Mason's photography missions, from Chapter 2
region: New Hanover — Heartlands, Albert Mason's horse
directions: During Albert Mason's photography stranger mission the Amber Champagne can be ridden away. The pin is that Heartlands encounter, near Carmody Dell.
note: Some guides also list a $950 Chapter 4 purchase. They disagree on the stable, so this pin stays on the mission horse.

title: Silver Dapple Pinto Missouri Fox Trotter
directions: The Blackwater stable sells the Silver Dapple Pinto Missouri Fox Trotter in the epilogue.
note: Epilogue only. It is not the Amber Champagne from Albert Mason's mission.
